items.title: Airbnb Is Building Its Own AI Travel Agent, Co-Founder Says
items.summary: Airbnb Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer Nathan Blecharczyk says the company is developing its own specialized AI travel agent that will eventually be able to book both on and off Airbnb's platform. In an interview with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse", he spoke about how AI is transforming Airbnb, the company's return to growth, regulation and housing in Europe, and the shift in travel beyond major cities.

items.title: Expedia, Booking and Airbnb fall as OpenAI reportedly buys AI travel platform
items.summary: Investing.com -- Online travel stocks fell to session lows Tuesday after The Information reported that OpenAI had acquired Odessia, an AI-powered travel planning platform, raising concerns about the potential for increased competition from artificial intelligence in the travel industry.
